text: 0199's turning grille with the filled grid copied out column by column: every card, a key of 1-3 letters or any key word of 7 letters or more, after or before.
The key-word arm needed longer than the hour allowed; the harness stopped the run at 3,660 seconds and nothing was written. My cost estimate was too low and the arm did not watch the clock.
0201: the same test with a faster search (the guesses about empty squares must nest), free keys to 4 letters, and a clock guard.
